hook: I got on the 610 in 2019. Still on it.
caption: Houston beta party: Jan 9. Leo got on the 610 in 2019 and missed the exit. Then missed it again. Then it was summer for six years. Finally, an exit worth taking. Tag the friend who is still on the 610.
